description: Elections Commission - Notice for Local Authorities in Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a "Notice of Poll" for local authorities elections in the Kurunegala District, specifying the election date and polling hours. It falls under the Elections category as it deals with electoral processes, specifically announcing the schedule for local government elections and listing the contested local authorities, which aligns with Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for electoral announcements and schedules.
